user.description: Only switches whose Home Assistant device exposes a power sensor are shown.

data_description.modes: Opeta ensin integraatiolle uuden lampun kirkkaustilat. Valitse lampun fyysisellä painikkeella jokainen taso ja lisää se alle, esimerkiksi High, Medium, Low ja Dim.
data_description.power_cycle_delay: Yleensä lisäviivettä ei tarvita. Jos omasta painikkeestaan sammutettu lamppu ei syty Home Assistantista, aseta pieni viive, esimerkiksi 0,7 s.
data_description.power_sensor: Only power sensors belonging to the selected smart plug are available here.
data_description.round_brightness_to_5: Rounds calculated brightness to the nearest 5%. Disable to use whole percentages without 5% steps.
data_description.power_history_samples: Number of consecutive power readings that must map to the same new mode before the integration switches modes. Until then, the current mode is kept unchanged. Default is 3.

abort.power_sensor_missing: No power sensor was found for the selected plug
